limitations: No Digital Macaroni hands-on recording, edit, export, upload, billing, or support test was completed.
Most user feedback comes from Product Hunt; the visible G2 and community samples are small.

claims.statement: Screen Studio is a macOS screen recorder that automatically adds zoom, cursor movement, framing, and other presentation effects.
Fast polished output for demos and tutorials is the main positive pattern.
Mac-only access, pricing, large files, audio work, annotations, and trimming are recurring limits.
The current plan costs $29 monthly or $9 monthly billed yearly, with all features and shareable links.

scoreRationale.onboarding: Recording and automatic polish appear quick; the real test is correcting mistakes and exporting the required format.
scoreRationale.product: Strong for short software demos on a Mac; not a full video editor or a cross-platform team recorder.
scoreRationale.support: No support request was tested and the available evidence is thin.
scoreRationale.billing: The yearly rate is much lower than monthly, so test the complete workflow before making the longer commitment.
scoreRationale.overall: Record the same real three-minute demo three times and keep Screen Studio only if the finished result needs less correction than the existing workflow.

conflictsAndUnknowns: Automatic zoom saves keyframing and can focus on the wrong place.
Visual polish helps a clear demo and cannot repair a weak script or bad audio.
No hands-on recording, export, sharing, cancellation, or support test was completed.
